exposure: Vitamin D-related genetic risk scores (vitamin D-GRS, VDR-GRS, non-VDR GRS)
cohort: The study participants were 183 healthy singleton Minangkabau pregnant mother and infant pairs.
finding: The study identified a novel interaction where pregnant mothers with higher carbohydrate intake and carrying >= 2 risk alleles of VDR-GRS gave birth to babies with significantly lower birth lengths.
